strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical teaching background
Proven track record in agile practices and CI/CD infrastructure
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not sufficient for client collaboration
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, with negligible Java experience
Overqualified and senior-level, making fit for entry-level role highly unlikely
